title: NASA Made Atoms 10 Billion Times Colder Than a Nebula
hook: NASA made atoms 10 billion times colder than a nebula.
closing: The deepest cold in this comparison is engineered, not naturally found.
question: What would you study there?

segments.say: Deep space sits near 2.7 kelvin. Even the cosmic background remains above absolute zero.
NASA's lab reaches 0.0000000001 kelvin. Its engineered atoms beat the natural cold in this comparison.
The laboratory orbits about 250 miles away. Humanity's coldest example is close enough to circle overhead.
